assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.description:
An exam examining concepts taught in lectures and practicals.
The Final Exam is a hurdle assessment. This means that, in addition to your overall unit mark, you are required to attempt the Final Exam and achieve a minimum mark of 40% to pass the Unit.
